passage: In 2019, engineers in the town of Larkfield installed small sensors along the Old Mill Bridge. The sensors measure how much the bridge bends when trucks cross it. Before the sensors, inspectors could check the bridge only twice a year; now the town receives daily reports and can schedule repairs before small problems become dangerous.
stem: According to the text, what is one benefit of the sensors?
choices: They give the town daily information so it can fix problems early.
They allow much heavier trucks to cross the bridge safely than before.
They make it unnecessary for engineers to design any new bridges.
They reduce how much the bridge bends each time a truck crosses.
steps: Find the sentence about what changed: inspections twice a year versus daily reports now.
Daily reports let the town schedule repairs before problems become dangerous.
The sensors only measure bending; they don't reduce it, allow heavier trucks, or replace design work.
